Here, we report that the CA2 region also contains recurrent excitatory monosynaptic couplings. Using dual whole\u2010cell patch\u2010clamp recordings from CA2 pyramidal cells in mouse hippocampal slices under differential interference contrast microscopic controls, we evaluated monosynaptic excitatory connections. Unitary excitatory postsynaptic potentials occurred in 1.4% of 502 cell pairs. These connected pairs were preferentially located in the superficial layer and proximal part (CA2b) of the CA2 region. These results indicate that recurrent excitatory circuits are denser in the CA2 region than in the CA1 region, as well as in the CA3 region.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1002\/hipo.23064","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2018,12,26]],"date-time":"2018-12-26T23:02:14Z","timestamp":1545865334000},"page":"305-312","update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1002\/crossmark_policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":31,"title":["Recurrent connections between CA2 pyramidal cells"],"prefix":"10.1002","volume":"29","author":[{"given":"Kazuki","family":"Okamoto","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"Laboratory of Chemical Pharmacology, Graduate School of Pharmaceutical Sciences The University of Tokyo  Tokyo Japan"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0003-2260-8191","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Yuji","family":"Ikegaya","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Laboratory of Chemical Pharmacology, Graduate School of Pharmaceutical Sciences The University of Tokyo  Tokyo Japan"},{"name":"Center for Information and Neural Networks National Institute of Information and Communications Technology  Suita Japan"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"311","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2018,12,26]]},"reference":[{"key":"e_1_2_5_2_1","unstructured":"AmariS CichockiA YangHH.1996.A new learning algorithm for blind signal separation.
